about_the_game:
Still bummed about crashing your drone? Can't even get out of the beginner zone? Yo, FPV peeps! A legit game-changer that lets you rule the skies from your bedroom is here!

🎮 Even the most butter-fingered can level up in 7 days with this epic cheat code!

This sim's got a "fan-favorite" teaching system! Newbs with the shakes, rejoice! The built-in teaching system starts with every basic RC move and pairs it with super fun training content. You'll be learning and having a blast, smoothly transitioning to real flight. Watching others crash while you show off is pure gold!

💥 The God Editor fires up your creative juices like never before!

That's right, your imagination is the only limit! Drag-and-drop 3D editor + zero-coding interaction tool:

✅ Whip up a dream track in just 10 seconds

✅ Craft your own "wind tunnel hell" hover challenge

✅ Develop Whac-a-Mole or coin battle gameplay

This ain't just another simulator; it's your personal metaverse!

🌍 Five mind-blowing scenes are ready to roll

Fly through cyberpunk cities, explore jungle mysteries, or cruise around desert airports... Get the early bird version now and enjoy:

🔥 Lifetime free scene updates

🔥 Early access to community features

🔥 One-on-one feedback channel with devs

🌟 Developer's vibe check:

"We're not making a boring sim. We're building a global flyer's paradise! We've got you covered on all your wildest ideas!"

One last time: Say no to crashes! Let's fly and vibe!

name: XFlight

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel 8th gen / AMD Ryzen 1st gen - 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 960 / AMD Radeon HD 7750 - 2GB VRAM or more.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 需要使用无人机遥控器或游戏手柄游玩
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 & Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel 10th gen / AMD Ryzen 3rd gen - 3.0GHz or faster.
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 2060 / AMD RX Vega 56 - 4GB VRAM or more.
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 需要使用无人机遥控器或游戏手柄游玩
